title: U.S. Department of Justice Marble Paperweight Commercial Emblem Seal - Rare DOJ
descriptionText: The U.S. Department of Justice Marble Paperweight is a rare and unique collectible item featuring the commercial emblem seal of the DOJ. Made of marble with a multicolor design, this paperweight proudly showcases the emblem of the United States Department of Justice. A perfect decorative piece for collectors or those interested in government memorabilia, this paperweight is a distinctive and meaningful addition to any collection. Made in the United States, this paperweight serves as a symbol of justice and patriotism.
